answer_1.quote: To evaluate text quality, we followed the Waterbench framework and tested four downstream tasks: Factual Knowledge, Long-form QA, Code Completion, and Text Summarization.

answer_2.quote: Watermark detectability is evaluated using True Positive Rate (TPR), True Negative Rate (TNR), Best F1 Score, and AUC metrics. [...] To assess the fluency of watermarked text, we used LLaMA2-7B to compute the perplexity (PPL) [...] The F1 score is chosen as the evaluation metric [...] and Rouge-L is employed [...]
